86 THE SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE

the evening of the 22d alt., with G. E. Davis, president, Miss Kate Ring, vice-president, and V. M. Tyler, secretary.

The following program was most successfully carried out:

DECLAMATION

A. K. Suddith (Ph.), B. F. Holcomb (Ph.)

ESSAY

Miss Hattie Darrell, Hon. member of G. E. C.

DEBATE

Affirmative, W. A. Attelsey, Ph.; Miss Julia Hunt, G. M. N.

Negative, L. A. Clark, Ph.; Miss Lee Lindsey, G. E. C.

ORATION

L. J. Reynolds, Hon. member of Pia. Society.

The exercises throughout were made enjoyable by Mr. and Mrs. Harry Naylor, Dr. Thomas, and his charming daughters.
